title: Typing Basics
summary: Learn about the home row and how to type faster.

steps.boltSpeech: Want to type really fast? There is a secret trick!

content.text: The secret to typing fast without looking is starting with your fingers on the HOME ROW.

points.text: Left hand rests on A, S, D, F.
Right hand rests on J, K, L, ;.
Your thumbs rest on the big Spacebar.

questions.prompt: Which letters are the resting place for your LEFT hand?
questions.explanation: A, S, D, F is the left half of the Home Row.

questions.prompt: Which finger should you use to press the Spacebar?

steps.boltSpeech: Let's practice finding the home row letters!
steps.instructions: Type the letters A, S, D, F, J, K, L in order.

points.text: Always bring your fingers back to the Home Row.
Keep your eyes on the screen, not the keys!
